availabilityEvidence.researchNotes: This workbook row matches the standard 2021 Black Shark 4, not the Snapdragon 888 Black Shark 4 Pro. Philippine sources identify four separate configurations: 6/128, 8/128, 12/128, and 12/256. 2021 launch SRPs remain historical price evidence. On 2026-11-26, KIMSTORE listed the exact 8/128 option at PHP 20,545 with one left and Add to cart; item condition was not stated, so the catalog leaves condition Not recorded. Other configurations have no verified current offer. A 2021 NTC GEC says PRS-H0 while a later regional transcription says PS-H0. YugaTech reports a polycarbonate rear while GSMArena/NanoReview list glass, and fingerprint placement also conflicts; those fields are not silently resolved. An exact official product image was located, but reuse rights are undocumented and the neutral placeholder remains.

availabilityEvidence.availabilityStatus: Philippine official sale reported from July 2, 2022 through Black Shark's official Shopee Philippines store and pop-up booth; NTC's 2022 GEC lists BLACK SHARK SHARK PAR-H0.
availabilityEvidence.philippineAvailability: The standard Black Shark 5 was announced for local sale in official Black Shark Philippines channels. YugaTech and REVU report July 2, 2022; NTC lists its SHARK PAR-H0 code. This verifies Philippine availability of the model family and the two launch configurations, while the workbook's scope status remains Pending.
availabilityEvidence.researchNotes: Matched to the standard Black Shark 5, not Black Shark 5 Pro. The NTC 2022 GEC lists BLACK SHARK SHARK PAR-H0 and the model manual names PAR-H0; GSMArena uses PAR-A0 for a separate global/regional code, whose band table is not used for the PH unit. Black Shark's manufacturer press release states the series was unveiled to the global market on June 9, 2022; this is recorded separately from the Philippine official sale date of July 2, 2022 reported by YugaTech and REVU. YugaTech and REVU support two local RAM/storage variants: 8/128 and 12/256, with launch SRPs PHP 26,999 and PHP 34,999 and early-bird prices PHP 25,999 and PHP 33,999 (July 2–18, 2022). On 2026-11-26 Bermor showed both exact RAM/storage configurations active and in stock at its online warehouse, with listed sale prices PHP 24,995 and PHP 32,450; condition is not stated. Camera sensor details, Bluetooth version, and the audio jack conflict between reviewed sources and remain unresolved. An exact official Black Shark product image was located, but reuse terms are not established, so the neutral placeholder remains. The inventory scope label is retained as Pending.

availabilityEvidence.researchNotes: Matched to Black Shark 5 Pro / SHARK KTUS-H0, not the standard Black Shark 5. The NTC GEC names the marketing model and code; the manufacturer manual confirms the same code. Global manufacturer release is June 9, 2022; Philippine official sale was reported from July 2. Local launch variants are 8/128 at PHP 37,999 and 12/256 at PHP 43,999; early-bird prices were PHP 36,999 and PHP 42,999 from July 2–18, 2022. Gufi's indexed listing shows a PHP 41,199–44,199 range, but the index is about four months old and does not map the two bounds to exact variants or verify present stock, so public current prices remain blank. The alternate blackshark.gg spec page conflicts with local and Xiaomi technical sources on camera and radio values; disputed public fields stay blank. An exact official product image was located, but image reuse rights are undocumented, so the placeholder remains. The workbook scope label remains Pending.

availabilityEvidence.philippineAvailability: YugaTech and other Philippine launch coverage report the Moto G50 5G with 4 GB RAM / 128 GB storage available locally at PHP 10,495. NTC GEC confirms Philippine conformity record ESD-GEC-2106805 for XT2149-1; Motorola's DoC maps XT2149-1 to moto g50 5G. The workbook row's shorter Moto G50 label is retained while the Philippine model match is explicitly identified as Moto G50 5G. Workbook scope remains Pending.
availabilityEvidence.researchNotes: The workbook row is labeled Moto G50. Philippine launch sources identify the locally available device as Moto G50 5G, 4 GB / 128 GB, MediaTek Dimensity 700. Motorola's official DoC maps XT2149-1 to moto g50 5G and separately maps XT2137-1 to the non-5G-suffixed moto g50; the NTC GEC records Philippine model XT2149-1. This review therefore matches the workbook row to the specific Philippine Moto G50 5G record and does not import the Snapdragon 480 specification of XT2137-1. availabilityEvidence.availabilityStatus: Philippine launch and Digital Walker preorder reported July 23, 2021; NTC records local DN2103 equipment conformity for Digits Trading Corp. No currently purchasable exact-variant local price was verified.
availabilityEvidence.philippineAvailability: YugaTech reports the OnePlus Nord 2 5G's Philippine unveiling and preorder at Digital Walker beginning July 23, 2021, with two exact local configurations: 8 GB / 128 GB Blue Haze at PHP 21,990 and 12 GB / 256 GB Gray Sierra at PHP 25,990. NTC records DN2103 / Nord 2 5G for Digits Trading Corp. Two NTC report copies disagree on the grant number (2106881 vs 2106851), while the model code, marketing name, applicant, and issue date agree. Workbook scope remains Pending.
availabilityEvidence.researchNotes: The workbook label OnePlus Nord 2 matches the Philippine-market Nord 2 5G model DN2103. OnePlus's manufacturer press release is dated July 21, 2021; local launch coverage reports preorder starting July 23. NTC records model DN2103 as Nord 2 5G for Digits Trading Corp on July 30, but two regional NTC report copies differ on the grant number (ESD-GEC-2106881 vs ESD-GEC-2106851), so both are retained as a source discrepancy. Philippine launch evidence supports two separate variants, Blue Haze 8/128 GB at PHP 21,990 and Gray Sierra 12/256 GB at PHP 25,990. OnePlus's published specification page provides detailed model specifications, while MediaTek supplies chipset-level process/CPU details. The Digital Walker URL linked from the 2021 article returned 404 on November 26, 2026. A Shopee result for DN2103 12/256 listed PHP 22,885 after voucher but marked the item Sold Out and displayed a stale November 2-9 delivery estimate; it is not treated as a current purchasable price. Current exact-variant prices remain Not recorded. The OnePlus product page links a Gray Sierra image, but reuse permission is not stated; the neutral placeholder remains. Workbook scope stays Pending.

availabilityEvidence.availabilityStatus: OPPO Philippines reported official Reno5 4G availability beginning February 20, 2021; NTC lists model CPH2159 for Philippine OPPO Mobile Technology Inc. Workbook eligibility remains Pending.
availabilityEvidence.philippineAvailability: OPPO Philippines states the Reno5 4G was officially available locally from February 20, 2021, and its NTC listing includes CPH2159. OPPO's model page identifies CPH2159 as Reno5 4G. The same Philippine release describes Reno5 5G separately; that model is not merged into this workbook's generic Reno5 row.
availabilityEvidence.researchNotes: The workbook's raw claim lists only 'Reno5' and contains no source URL or connectivity suffix. OPPO's model-specific page calls the base product OPPO Reno5 4G and identifies it as CPH2159; the Philippine NTC list includes CPH2159, while separately naming CPH2145 as Reno5 5G. OPPO Philippines independently confirms that Reno5 4G and Reno5 5G were distinct Philippine products, so their specifications and prices are not combined. The 4G model's exact local configuration is 8 GB / 128 GB, with Fantasy Silver and Starry Black color options. OPPO says local availability began February 20, 2021; YugaTech reports the PHP 18,999 launch price. A 2021 official OPPO promotion temporarily lowered the price to PHP 16,999 through July 31, 2021. GSMArena reports an announcement on December 31, 2020 and a release on January 9, 2021, while Kimovil gives December 2020; OPPO's reviewed pages provide no global date, so no single date is assigned. OPPO says CPH2159 lacks NFC, while GSMArena's entry lists NFC as region-dependent; local NFC remains unresolved. GSMArena records an Android 12 / ColorOS 12 upgrade path, but OPPO does not state a software-support duration. Current price references conflict or are not checkout offers: Shoppable displays a new-condition SRP but requires a quote, GreenTelcom's product price conflicts with its category's out-of-stock label, and Pinoy Techno Guide is a price list rather than a seller. Current purchasable price remains unverified and blank. OPPO's official product page has exact-model images, but no reusable image permission was established; the neutral placeholder remains. Workbook scope stays Pending.

availabilityEvidence.availabilityStatus: Philippine preorder coverage identifies Digital Walker, later reported as OnePlus's official Philippine distributor, with NTC GEC listing NE2213 as OnePlus 10 Pro 5G. Workbook eligibility remains Pending.
availabilityEvidence.philippineAvailability: The OnePlus 10 Pro 5G was announced for the Philippines in April 2022 and offered for preorder through Digital Walker from April 2 to April 6. Later reports say it was available nationwide through Digital Walker. The documented Philippine configuration is 12 GB / 256 GB in Volcanic Black and Emerald Forest, with PHP 52,990 SRP and PHP 48,990 preorder promotion. Current stock and price are not verified.
availabilityEvidence.researchNotes: Workbook row 86 OnePlus 10 Pro matches NTC model NE2213 / OnePlus 10 Pro 5G. Philippine preorder reporting identifies one local hardware configuration, 12 GB / 256 GB, offered in Volcanic Black and Emerald Forest. The colors share identical memory/storage and remain one configuration. Local SRP is PHP 52,990; PHP 48,990 was a dated April 2-6 preorder offer. The OnePlus global specification lists LPDDR5 and 80 W wired charging, while Philippine secondary sources disagree on LPDDR5X versus LPDDR5 and 65 W versus 80 W; the catalog leaves those fields unresolved. Some sources claim IP68 but exact NE2213 coverage is not consistent, so ingress protection remains blank. Current local price is blank. Exact official product images are available but reuse rights are not stated, so the neutral placeholder remains. Workbook eligibility is Pending.
availabilityEvidence.qualityFlag: NE2213 model match, local 12/256 configuration, colors, SRP, and preorder price verified; current price unavailable; RAM type, wired charging, display brightness, and IP rating conflicts preserved; workbook eligibility remains Pending.

availabilityEvidence.philippineAvailability: Samsung Newsroom Philippines identifies the Galaxy Z Flip5 as a Philippine-market model with 8GB/256GB and 8GB/512GB storage, official SRPs of PHP 64,990 and PHP 71,990, and general availability beginning 18 August 2023. Samsung Philippines product pages identify local product codes SM-F731BZEAPHL (Cream 256GB) and SM-F731BZAEPHL (Graphite 512GB); the base model family is SM-F731B. The 512GB configuration was included in a time-limited free double-storage preorder offer at the 256GB price. Samsung product pages showed Not for sale on 26 November 2026; no current price is recorded. One UNBOX PH video lists PHP 65,990 for 256GB, differing from Samsung's official PHP 64,990 SRP and other local reporting; the official value is retained with the alternate claim in the field audit.
availabilityEvidence.philippineDateLabel: General availability began 18 August 2023; Philippine preorders began 26 July
availabilityEvidence.researchNotes: Workbook row 163 Samsung Z Flip5 matches the Philippine Galaxy Z Flip5 (SM-F731B) in distinct 8GB/256GB and 8GB/512GB configurations. Samsung Philippines lists official launch SRPs of PHP 64,990 and PHP 71,990 and states general availability began 18 August 2023. Eligible preorders from 26 July through 17 August received a free storage upgrade, allowing 512GB at the 256GB price; this campaign is recorded separately from SRP. Samsung product pages now display Not for sale, so current price remains blank. An UNBOX PH launch video lists PHP 65,990 for 256GB; Samsung's official release, YugaTech and Revu report PHP 64,990, so the manufacturer price is used and the alternate claim retained. YugaTech labels RAM as LPDDR5 while GSMArena says LPDDR5X; the memory-generation field is left unresolved. Workbook study scope remains Pending.
availabilityEvidence.qualityFlag: Samsung Philippines launch and both 8/256 and 8/512 configurations verified; historical SRPs and preorder terms recorded; alternate 256GB price and conflicting LPDDR5/LPDDR5X claims preserved; current local price not for sale/unverified; image reuse rights not established; study scope remains Pending.

availabilityEvidence.philippineAvailability: Samsung Newsroom Philippines lists local SRPs of PHP 98,990, PHP 105,990 and PHP 119,990 for 12GB/256GB, 12GB/512GB and 12GB/1TB and says general availability began 18 August 2023. Local product pages identify exact examples SM-F946BZKDPHL (Phantom Black 256GB), SM-F946BZUGPHL (Gray 512GB online-exclusive) and SM-F946BZEHPHL (Cream 1TB). Samsung Philippines support identifies the base regional model as SM-F946B/DS. Its three reviewed product pages showed Not for sale on 26 November 2026, so current prices remain blank. The July–August preorder campaign offered 512GB for the 256GB price and reduced the 1TB price to PHP 112,990; these are preserved as historical promotions, not current prices.
availabilityEvidence.philippineDateLabel: General availability began 18 August 2023; Philippine preorders began 26 July
availabilityEvidence.researchNotes: Workbook row 164 Samsung Z Fold5 matches the Philippine Galaxy Z Fold5 family SM-F946B/DS in three separate 12GB configurations: 256GB, 512GB and 1TB. Samsung Philippines confirms the local model, official SRPs and 18 August 2023 general availability; the 512GB preorder upgrade and 1TB discount are stored separately. All three sampled official local product pages showed Not for sale, so current prices remain blank. RAM generation is withheld because Samsung Poland lists LPDDR5 while GSMArena and NanoReview say LPDDR5X. Video capture maximum is also withheld because the Philippines product page says 8K30 and GSMArena says 8K24/4K60. Image reuse rights were not established; study scope remains Pending.

sources.purpose: Philippine manufacturer technical specifications for display, chip, cameras, connectivity, battery, accessories and supported capacities

sources.purpose: Cross-check of detailed model specifications and Wi-Fi/cellular weights
sources.note: Apple's model-specific support page lists year introduced 2025; the same display, chip, camera and capacity specifications; Wi-Fi weight 477g and Wi-Fi + Cellular weight 481g; 28.93Wh lithium-polymer battery; and camera video modes.

sources.purpose: Exact storage/connectivity list price and current local product listing
sources.note: Apple Philippines buy page lists the 512 GB / Wi-Fi configuration at PHP 53,990 on 2026-11-27. This is a dated manufacturer-store list price; stock, delivery estimate and checkout completion were not verified.

sources.purpose: Cross-check of all exact configuration options, colors and prices
sources.note: Apple's Philippines buy page exposes all six storage/connectivity configurations: 128GB, 256GB and 512GB in Wi-Fi and Wi-Fi + Cellular. sources.purpose: Manufacturer model announcement and global availability date
sources.note: Apple announced iPad (A16) on 2025-03-04, opened pre-orders that day, and said it would begin arriving and reach Apple Stores/authorized resellers on 2025-03-12. It lists 128GB/256GB/512GB, four colors, and Wi-Fi/Wi-Fi + Cellular versions.

sources.purpose: Product-specific environmental report and enclosure-material evidence

sources.purpose: Apple EU product-information label for the exact A3354 Wi-Fi model, including ingress-protection classification

sources.purpose: Dated Philippine authorized-reseller availability report

availabilityEvidence.researchNotes: Workbook row 49 is matched to the 2021 M1 iPad Pro family. Apple documents two distinct configurations by size/generation: 11-inch (3rd generation) and 12.9-inch (5th generation). This record is represented as five storage capacities × Wi-Fi/Wi-Fi + Cellular for each size (20 exact configurations). Apple maps Wi-Fi/cellular variants to A2377/A2459 (11-inch) and A2378/A2461 (12.9-inch); US mmWave and China-only model numbers are not substituted. REVU reported PH availability by 2021-05-27 and listed exact prices; the first-sale timing remains unresolved because YugaTech sources conflict. Battery is retained in Wh as Apple reports it. Current prices and stock are not asserted. Apple image candidates are preserved for rights review; the public catalog keeps the neutral placeholder. Study scope remains Pending.

sources.purpose: Dated initial global Apple Store/authorized reseller availability

Apple documents two distinct configurations by size/generation: 11-inch (3rd generation) and 12.9-inch (5th generation). This record is represented as five storage capacities × Wi-Fi/Wi-Fi + Cellular for each size (20 exact configurations). Apple maps Wi-Fi/cellular variants to A2377/A2459 (11-inch) and A2378/A2461 (12.9-inch); US mmWave and China-only model numbers are not substituted. REVU reported PH availability by 2021-05-27 and listed exact prices; the first-sale timing remains unresolved because YugaTech sources conflict. Battery is retained in Wh as Apple reports it. Current prices and stock are not asserted. Apple image candidates are preserved for rights review; the public catalog keeps the neutral placeholder. Study scope remains Pending.

sources.purpose: Announcement, product overview, launch software and global preorder window
sources.note: Apple announced the M1 iPad Pro on 2021-04-20, described 128GB through 2TB capacities, 5G for cellular models, eSIM, external storage, accessories, 100% recycled aluminum, and iPadOS 14.5; initial availability was set for the second half of May.

sources.purpose: Dated initial global Apple Store/authorized reseller availability
sources.note: Apple's 2021-05-18 update says deliveries and store/authorized reseller availability around the world began Friday 2021-05-21. This does not establish the first Philippine sale.

sources.purpose: Refresh-rate range of ProMotion on iPad Pro
sources.note: Apple Developer documents ProMotion on iPad Pro as dynamically switching between 24Hz and 120Hz; the 2021 size-specific Apple specs identify ProMotion on both models.

sources.purpose: Contemporaneous Philippine configuration price report before local availability was announced

sources.purpose: Dated Philippine availability report and matching variant prices

sources.purpose: Updated 2021 Philippine tablet list with variant prices and a reported launch month

availabilityEvidence.researchNotes: The exact model matches Xiaomi Pad 6S Pro 12.4. Philippine launch coverage supports two Wi-Fi configurations: 8/256 and 12/512. Xiaomi global specifications confirm the shared technical platform and Xiaomi's global support FAQ explicitly confirms no SIM slot. Local launch prices were PHP 33,999 and PHP 39,999. Current retailer listings observed 2026-11-27 show PHP 22,999 for 8/256 at iWarehouse (one listed location, stock not reserved) and PHP 39,999 for 12/512 at Home Credit (installment path shown, branch stock/condition not confirmed). A Gigahertz/PriceMe 8/256 observation of PHP 35,199 on 2026-05-06 is retained as historical; Gigahertz now marks it sold out. Xiaomi annual report says launched in February 2024 while an official FAQ gives March 25 without clarifying market; local coverage reports PH availability by May 2. Exact model number and first authorized local-sale date are not inferred. Xiaomi global and PH color names differ in sources; colors do not split hardware variants. The exact-model Wikimedia Commons photograph is cached in the project under CC BY-SA 4.0 with creator credit and license links in the image manifest. Study scope remains Pending.

sources.purpose: Local configuration table and launch specifications
sources.note: Samsung Philippines lists Android 13.0, an 11-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display, 60–120 Hz refresh rate, dimensions, Wi-Fi/5G weights, cameras, 8/128 and 12/256 GB versions, processor and 8,400 mAh typical battery.

sources.purpose: Authorized local preorder window, pickup timing, SRPs and preorder offers
sources.note: Official terms show the July 26–August 17, 2023 local preorder period; customers could get preorder units as early as August 11. They list device SRPs and the 256 GB preorder prices with a free within-series storage upgrade.

sources.purpose: Dated confirmation of Philippine store and online availability
sources.note: Samsung Philippines reported the series available through participating local stores and online channels by September 6, 2023. This confirms local availability but not the exact first general-sale transaction.

sources.purpose: Dated Philippine launch price cross-check
sources.note: Samsung Newsroom Philippines published variant SRPs on September 8, 2023: Wi-Fi 8/128 PHP 47,990, Wi-Fi 12/256 PHP 54,990, 5G 8/128 PHP 56,990, and 5G 12/256 PHP 63,990.

sources.purpose: Global announcement, availability timing, support policy and shared model specifications
sources.note: Samsung announced the Tab S9 series July 26, 2023 and said general availability in select markets began August 11, 2023. The global launch material identifies the Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 for Galaxy, IP68, included S Pen, Armor Aluminum and four OS generations plus five years of security updates.

sources.purpose: Global market availability start date
sources.note: Samsung says the Galaxy Tab S9 series launched in selected markets on August 11, 2023; additional markets followed later.

sources.purpose: Manufacturer charging capability
sources.note: Samsung support states that Galaxy Tab S9 models support 45 W Fast Charging 2.0 with a compatible charger and cable. This does not imply the charger is included.

sources.purpose: Manufacturer SIM capability for model codes SM-X716B / SM-X710
sources.note: Samsung's model-family table maps SM-X716B to the cellular model and identifies Nano-SIM (4FF) plus eSIM. The Wi-Fi-only SM-X710 does not take a SIM.

sources.purpose: Chip process and platform-level technical details
sources.note: Qualcomm lists the Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 at 4 nm and a maximum CPU frequency up to 3.36 GHz; Samsung's exact Galaxy Tab S9 local product pages identify the Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 for Galaxy.

sources.purpose: Independent exact-model specification cross-check
sources.note: GSMArena's Galaxy Tab S9 specification table reports the octa-core CPU layout, Adreno 740 graphics, UFS storage, Corning Gorilla Glass without a revision, SIM/eSIM on cellular models, cameras, dimensions and other model-family details.

sources.purpose: Secondary technical specifications and measurement references
sources.note: NanoReview lists LPDDR5X memory, screen brightness, storage and battery data for the Tab S9 family. Its page attributes measured display data to NotebookCheck; Samsung's Philippine product pages remain the primary source where available.

sources.purpose: Manufacturer software support commitment
sources.note: Samsung's Galaxy Tab S9 product environmental report says four generations of OS upgrades and five years of security updates.

sources.purpose: Dated official local discount terms by storage and connectivity variant

availabilityEvidence.availabilityStatus: Philippine series availability officially announced from 2023-10-20; exact 8/128 Wi-Fi and 8/128 5G local SKUs identified.
availabilityEvidence.philippineAvailability: Samsung Philippines announced FE-series local availability from October 20, 2023. Its local pages identify Galaxy Tab S9 FE+ Gray Wi-Fi 8/128 (SM-X610NZAAXTC) and 5G 8/128 (SM-X616BZAA XTC). Samsung PH mentions storage up to 256 GB with regional availability caveats, but no exact local 12/256 SKU and configuration-specific local price were verified; non-PH regional SKU codes were not treated as local evidence.
availabilityEvidence.qualityFlag: Two exact local 8/128 SKUs identified; current price, exact 12/256 Philippine SKU, display peak brightness condition and battery chemistry remain unresolved.

openIssues.issue: Samsung Philippines mentions up to 256 GB, with availability varying by market; no exact PH 12 GB / 256 GB SKU or local configuration-specific price was verified.
openIssues.action: Do not list 12/256 as a confirmed Philippine variant until a Samsung Philippines SKU or authorized local configuration-level listing is found.

openIssues.issue: Samsung Philippines did not expose a current numeric price for either exact 8/128 SKU on the review date.
openIssues.action: Keep current price blank and retain dated historical local prices separately.

openIssues.issue: Samsung Philippines states 600 nits maximum and 720 nits outdoor HBM; NanoReview gives 800 nits max-rated without a matching test-mode definition.
openIssues.action: Keep peak brightness unresolved until comparable measurement conditions are documented.
